title: Geofence Location Export Freshness
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:geofence source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures geofence export lag by data source for care-location feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside care-location feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `geofence export lag` on `care:geofence` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst geofence export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how long things take for each data source so you can see where care-location feeds slows down.
